t_live_docs_body:
Welcome to Help! Keep this little window open while you work on the notebook, and you will get the R documentation of everything you type.

You can also type a query above.
t_panel_docs_description: Help: Search for R documentation, and get live documentation of everything you type.
t_panel_packages_description: Packages: the notebook's R packages and their install status.
t_panel_variables_description: Variables: every value a cell has defined.
t_ember_variables_empty: Variables appear here once a cell defines one.
t_ember_variables_stale_title: Stale: its cell needs a run
t_ember_r_status_restart_title: Restart R to use the new versions of: {{names}}
t_ember_status_restart_hint: Restarting clears every variable; cells stay as they are, marked not run.
t_ember_status_mode_autorun: Rerun the cells that depend on it
t_ember_status_mode_lazy: Mark them stale and let me run them
t_ember_safe_preview_plan_install_one: Running starts R and installs {{count}} package.
t_ember_safe_preview_plan_install_other: Running starts R and installs {{count}} packages.
t_ember_safe_preview_plan_restart: Running starts R; it will then restart to use a new version of: {{names}}.
t_ember_safe_preview_banner: Safe preview: nothing in this notebook has run. Read the code, then run it if you trust it.
t_ember_packages_tab_description: The packages this notebook loads, installed for it alone.
t_ember_packages_update_restart_question: Updating changes {{names}}, which R has loaded. R will restart and cells will need to run again.
t_ember_install_failed_compile_dependenc: A package it needs, {{dep}} {{version}}, doesn't build on R {{r_version}}.
t_ember_install_failed_download: It couldn't be downloaded. Check the internet connection.
t_ember_install_failed_other: It needs a system library that isn't installed.
t_hint_run_add: <kbd>{{mod}}</kbd> + <kbd>Enter</kbd> runs it and adds a cell below.
t_hint_text: Start a line with <kbd>#'</kbd> to write text instead of code.
t_language_picker_description: Change the language of the interface
t_rail_due_hint: Press Shift + Enter to run this cell
t_multiple_definitions_for_one: {{symbols}} is defined in more than one cell. Keep one, or put them in one cell.
t_multiple_definitions_for_other: {{symbols}} are each defined in more than one cell. Keep one of each, or put them in one cell.
t_cyclic_references_among_one: {{symbols}} depends on itself, so it can't run.
t_cyclic_references_between_two: {{symbols}} depend on each other, so neither can run.
t_cyclic_references_among_other: {{symbols}} depend on each other, so none of them can run.
t_aria_label_text_cell: Text cell. Press Enter to edit its source.
t_settings_scope: For every notebook in this browser
t_settings_autocomplete_note: Ctrl + Space suggests them either way.
t_settings_tab_key_note: Either way, Esc and then Tab leaves the cell.
t_settings_long_runs_note: When a change would rerun cells that took longer than this last time.
t_settings_notify: Notify me when a long run finishes
t_settings_notify_note: A browser notification after runs longer than a minute.
t_settings_notify_blocked: Your browser blocks notifications from this page.
t_confirm_long_run_one: This reruns {{count}} cell that took about {{time}} last time.
t_confirm_long_run_other: This reruns {{count}} cells that took about {{time}} last time.
t_export_download_r_description: The notebook itself. Runs with Rscript.
t_export_download_html_description: One file with every output. Opens offline.
t_export_safe_preview_note: This notebook hasn't run, so HTML and PDF have code but no outputs.
t_safe_preview_not_rendered: Scripts and styles not rendered in Safe preview
t_copy_output_action_description: Copy the output of this cell to the clipboard.
t_help_about_tab_navigation_inside_cell: Press <kbd>Esc</kbd> and then <kbd>Tab</kbd> to continue navigation.
t_ai_prompt_generator_intro: You can copy this text into an AI chat to give it context from your notebook.
t_copy_header_id_action_description: Click to copy URL to this header
t_ai_permission_prompt_title: Use AI to fix syntax errors?
t_ai_accept_and_close: Accept AI syntax fix and close
t_ai_decline_and_close: Decline AI syntax fix and close
t_ai_reject_and_revert: Reject and revert to original code
t_ai_fix_syntax_with_ai_description: Attempt to fix this syntax error using an LLM service
t_confirm_delete_multiple_interrupt_note: A cell you're deleting is still running. Stop it first, then delete.
t_page_error_reload: Something went wrong in this page. Reload it to continue.
t_ember_move_note: Moves the .R file. The notebook stays open and R keeps running. Code that reads files by relative path will look in the new folder.
t_ember_start_forget_title: Remove from this list. The file stays.
t_lost_authentication: This page lost its connection to Ember. Reload it to reconnect.
t_shortcut_run_add: Run it and add a cell below
t_shortcut_move: Move the cell up or down
t_shortcut_go_to_definition: Go to the cell that defines a name
t_shortcut_page: Go to the cell above or below
t_shortcut_leave: Leave the cell, keep it selected
t_shortcut_next_control: Next control after leaving a cell
t_shortcut_help: R help for the name at the cursor
t_bonds_static_warning: You are viewing a static document. {{run_notebook_action}} to enable interactivity.
t_edit_or_run_description_1: To be able to edit code and run cells, you need to run the notebook yourself.
t_edit_or_run_description_2: Where would you like to run the notebook?
t_edit_or_run_runtime: This notebook takes about {{runtime}} to run.
t_edit_or_run_local_description: (Recommended if you want to store your changes.)
t_edit_or_run_open_the_notebook_file_des: Type the saved filename in the open box.
t_plutoland_download_description: Save the HTML export file to your disk:
t_plutoland_download_description_recordi: Save the recording as an HTML file to your disk:
t_plutoland_upload_success: Uploaded! You can share this URL:
t_pkg_will_be_installed: {{package}} will be installed when you run this notebook.
t_pkg_not_found: The package {{package}} could not be found in the registry. Did you make a typo?
t_pkg_will_be_installed_in_notebook: {{package}} will be installed in the notebook when you run this cell.
t_pkg_installation_can_take:
Installation can take {{time_install}}.
Afterwards, it loads in {{time_load}}.
t_pkg_update_packages_description: Would you like to check for updates and install them? A backup of the notebook file will be created.
t_pkg_currently_busy: Pkg is currently busy with other packages... come back later!
t_pkg_click_to_open_pkg_popup: Click to open package details popup
t_save_all_changes_description: Save and run all changed cells
t_file_change_detected: The file changed on disk; the notebook now shows it.
t_project_toml_editor_description: This notebook has its own package environment. You can edit the Project.toml file to specify the packages used in this notebook.
t_project_toml_editor_compat_description: You can change the [compat] entries to specify the package versions used in this notebook. By adding [sources], you can use unregistered or local packages.
t_project_toml_editor_feature_preview_no: Note: This is a feature preview. It may not always work as expected. Please let us know what you think!
t_project_toml_editor_status_tab_note: After submitting, use the Status tab to see the logs.
t_project_toml_editor_backup_checkbox: Create a backup of the notebook before saving?
t_project_toml_editor_placeholder: This is a TOML file. You can set metadata for your project here.
t_project_toml_editor_wait_cells: Please wait for all cells to finish executing.
t_project_toml_editor_wait_packages: Please wait for all package operations to finish (also in other notebooks).
t_project_toml_editor_synchronized:
Project TOML synchronized ✔

View the Status tab for logs.
t_project_toml_editor_start_notebook_fir: You need to start the notebook before you can edit the Project.toml. This might be supported in the future.
